commit.message:
Update .zenodo.json to the paper's framing: three classifying attributes, drop one-command

- "four-axis classification (...Attacker Position)" -> three attributes (Attack
  Surface, Provenance, Blast Radius) with Attacker Position read as a deployment
  vantage, matching the paper's taxonomy.
- Drop the "one-command" phrasing (the paper removed that claim).

files.patch:
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 {
-  "title": "DS-Lite Security: a Reproducible Full-Stack Attack Testbed, 12 Executed Attacks, a Four-Axis Classification, and Verified Mitigations",
-  "description": "Reproducible artifact for the article \"A Verified, Reproducible Security Analysis of Dual-Stack Lite Across the Data, Control, and Management Planes\" (submitted to Computers & Security). Contains the one-command Docker testbed realizing the DS-Lite (RFC 6333) reference architecture across the data, control, and management planes; 12 attack tools spanning softwire spoofing/interception/injection/relay, fragment-reassembly poisoning, PCP third-party abuse and cross-subscriber enumeration, DNS and DHCPv6 AFTR-discovery hijacking, and DS-Lite MIB access over SNMP; an independent verifier (packet captures plus direct reads of the AFTR and B4 state, and observed device behavior) with the per-attack reference captures for the baseline, every attack, and every mitigation before and after it is applied; the four-axis attack classification (Attack Surface, Provenance, Blast Radius, Attacker Position) with its classifier and quality-verification scripts; one attack-defense tree per attack rendered with QuADTool; and the verified, reversible mitigations with their apply/verify scripts, including DECAP-BIND, the decapsulation-time source binding that instantiates the softwire ingress filter RFC 6333 leaves optional. Three further generic-CGNAT weaknesses (shared-address reputation poisoning, PCP port exhaustion, PCP epoch spoofing) are retained as supplementary tools, documented but outside the paper's executed corpus. The article is self-contained; this archive holds the supporting detail and regenerates every numerical result and capture from one command.",
